content.short: An NFT Auction House built on the Cardano Blockchain. We offer an alternative to the traditional NFT marketplace.
content.description:
The Dramz Auction House (DAH) is the only true NFT Auction House that exists on the Cardano Blockchain today.

The DAH provides an interactive, and exciting platform for buyers and sellers of any Cardano NFT to buy, sell or auction off their NFT. The DAH offers very competitive fees, and has a tailored membership program that is suited to anyone who is an occasional user, to the power, everyday user, and a live chat system that can rival any in-person auction.

There are great incentives to hold a DAH Membership Token, and the DAH is continuing to develop its auction platform and offering great incentives to our members.
